description: Keyword search over the catalog metadata (topic names, descriptions, tags, AND column names/descriptions) — the discovery entry point when you don't know the exact topic name. Returns lean topic summaries per hit with a relevance score and which fields matched, plus a `dimension_matches` list when the query also hits a dimension (e.g. 'district'). Most acronyms work; the short ones `ap`/`el`/`ib` are recognized. Follow up with describe_dataset. `limit` caps results (default 20, max 100).
name: search_datasets
